description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Machine build started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToDesign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToDesign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DesignToOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DesignToOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToHandOver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_HandOverSets" name="Hand over Lego sets to children">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToHandOver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOverToSort</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandOverToSort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SortToStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildStart" name="Subcomponent build start">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SortToStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RedesignToStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToFork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BuildFork" name="Build each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToFork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForkToEntry_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForkToEntry_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildEntry_1" name="Subcomponent 1 build entry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForkToEntry_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderToEntry_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck_1" name="Container has parts?" default="Flow_NoParts_1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasParts_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoParts_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts_1" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoParts_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderToEntry_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuildSubcomponent_1" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasParts_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuildToTest_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent_1" name="Test subcomponent individually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildToTest_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToJoin_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildEntry_2" name="Subcomponent 2 build entry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForkToEntry_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderToEntry_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck_2" name="Container has parts?" default="Flow_NoParts_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasParts_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoParts_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts_2" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoParts_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderToEntry_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuildSubcomponent_2" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasParts_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuildToTest_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent_2" name="Test subcomponent individually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildToTest_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToJoin_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="All subcomponents tested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToJoin_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToJoin_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllTested" name="All subcomponents tested successfully?" default="Flow_TestFailed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllDone</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RedesignToStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleMachine" name="Assemble subcomponents into machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineComplete" name="Machine completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDesign" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToOrder" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToHandOver" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_HandOverSets" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOverToSort" sourceRef="Task_HandOverSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToStart" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToFork" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildStart" targetRef="Gateway_BuildFork" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToEntry_1" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFork" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToEntry_2" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFork" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_1" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_1" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasParts_1" name="Yes, parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_1" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoParts_1" name="No, container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_1" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToEntry_1" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts_1" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTest_1" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent_1" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToJoin_1" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent_1" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EntryToPartsCheck_2" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_2" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasParts_2" name="Yes, parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_2" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoParts_2" name="No, container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_2" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToEntry_2" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts_2" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTest_2" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent_2" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToJoin_2" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent_2" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToResult" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AllTested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllDone" name="Yes, all tests successful" sourceRef="Gateway_AllTested" targetRef="Task_AssembleMachine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" name="No, rebuild required" sourceRef="Gateway_AllTested" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignToStart" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AssembleMachine" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineComplete" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
